comment_regular: Verified insertion into TESPathGrid.pointsByCell (+0x44), which is a per-PathGrid 512-unit X/Y spatial-bucket map despite the legacy member/type spelling. It derives the packed key from the node's NiPoint3, finds or creates a BSSimpleList header, then pushes the point pointer. The graph-chunk loader calls this for each loaded point; FindPointByPositionInCell uses the same key.
